result.user_query: What are the features of this product?
result.inference_text:
The OLIXIS Guest Reception Desk Chair includes:
• Comfortable Support – High-density sponge cushion with wide, full backrest to support your back and hips without nerve compression
• Premium Leather – High-grade PU leather that's waterproof, corrosion-resistant, and easy to clean
• Sturdy Metal Base – Four-point metal leg support with 275 lb weight capacity; glides on hard floors
• Padded Armrests – Soft leather armrests with cushioning for elbow support and stability
• Versatile Design – Suitable for reception rooms, offices, clinics, libraries, and dining areas
• Easy Assembly – Typically assembled in 20 minutes with included tools and instruction manual
• Dimensions – 22.24"W x 24.02"D x 32.68"H with 19.09" seat height
• Warranty – 1-year free warranty service
Customers report the chair works well for office guest seating and post-operative recovery, though assembly experiences and durability are mixed.
